characters.name: The Father
characters.prompt: A weary, middle-aged Norwegian man from the 1400-1850 period, living deep in the forest in simple, worn-out clothes, carrying a basic hunting musket, with a humble and caring expression.

characters.name: The Daughter
characters.prompt: A modestly dressed Norwegian girl in her late teens, from the 1400-1850 era, with braided hair and a kind face. She wears a simple linen dress and carries herself with gentle confidence.

characters.name: The Queen
characters.prompt: A regal Norwegian queen from the 1400-1850 period, wearing a finely embroidered gown, a modest crown, and an air of graceful authority. She keeps a watchful yet benevolent gaze.

characters.name: The Prince
characters.prompt: A handsome young Norwegian prince from the 1400-1850 era, wearing royal garments with subtle Nordic details. He has a welcoming smile and a dignified posture.

characters.name: First Aunt (Long Nose)
characters.prompt: An elderly Norwegian woman from the 1400-1850 period, hunched over in tattered clothing, with an extraordinarily elongated, crooked nose. Her demeanor is peculiar and slightly mischievous.

characters.name: Second Aunt (Broad Backside)
characters.prompt: A short, elderly Norwegian woman from the 1400-1850 era, struggling to fit through the doorway due to her unusually wide backside. She wears a ragged dress and carries herself with awkward confidence.

characters.name: Third Aunt (Large Red Eyes)
characters.prompt: An elderly Norwegian woman from the 1400-1850 period with large, watery red eyes. She appears tired and frail, wrapped in old, patched clothing and peering around nervously.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a grand marriage scene in rural Norway during the 1400-1850 period, inside a modest wooden hall. Show the beautiful young bride sitting beside the prince in regal attire, surrounded by the three bizarrely featured old aunts—one with an extremely long nose, another with a broad backside, and the last with huge red eyes. The queen stands nearby in her stately gown, while the humble father looks on gratefully. The room is lit by flickering torches, revealing Norwegian folk decorations and rough-hewn wooden beams.
modernMainImagePrompt: Picture a contemporary Norwegian wedding in a small church or community center, with a stylish bride in a simple white dress and a groom in a modern suit. The three aunts, each with exaggerated features (long nose, large backside, and big watery eyes), arrive unexpectedly in everyday clothing that seems out of place. A modern-day father in a slightly worn flannel shirt watches happily, while a poised wedding organizer, representing the queen, stands off to the side ensuring everything runs smoothly.
childMainImagePrompt: Draw a friendly, cozy wedding scene in a magical forest clearing in Norway, focusing on a smiling girl in a pretty dress and a happy prince in simple royal clothes. Three silly elderly aunties stand by with funny features (a long nose, a wide backside, and big blinking eyes) but kind faces. Gentle woodland animals peek out, and a warm glow of lanterns lights up the scene, making everything feel safe and cheerful for young children.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Lag et klart bilde av et bryllupsfest i Norge, der bruden er ei ung jente i en enkel kjole, og brudgommen er en kjekk prins. De tre rare tantene har hver sine spesielle trekk: lang nese, stor bakende og store røde øyne. Kongen eller dronningen står i elegante, men tradisjonelle klær. Stedet skal se gammelt norsk ut, med trepanel og enkelt, koselig interiør.
englishMainImagePrompt: Create a detailed illustration of a Norwegian wedding feast set in olden times. The bride, a modest young woman, is seated next to the prince at a long wooden table under torchlight. The three peculiar aunts each have their own striking features: an extended nose, a broad backside, and large red eyes. The queen watches with pride in her stately garments. The rustic surroundings reflect Norway’s forested countryside between the 1400s and 1850s.
